notes.title: Shadow Puppeteer Developer Stream!
notes.content:
Welcome to the mystical world of Shadow Puppeteer, where you join the adventures of the boy and his shadow. 

Invite a friend to explore the strange, yet beautiful world of darkness and light
in Shadow Puppeteer, an award-winning, local co-op adventure.

In this livestream, we will be playing Shadow Puppeteer with the developer team and new Sarepta members (who will join a blind playthrough!). We also will be testing the new "Remote Play Together" function of Steam and will play the game with community members.


[i][b]What is Shadow Puppeteer?[/b][/i]
Shadow Puppeteer is the very first game of Sarepta studio where you assume the roles of a boy and his shadow, separated from one another by the evil shadow puppeteer. 

In this co-op adventure, you work together to manipulate light, solving puzzles that bring you closer to finding this villain and freeing other shadows he has stolen.

[i][b]Who is Sarepta studio?[/b][/i]
We are the people behind awards winning games like Shadow Puppeteer & My Child Lebensborn! Also, we are the people you'll see in this livestream. At Sarepta, we enjoy creating emotional and atmospheric games that stay with you even after the gameplay is done. In other words - we enjoy making people cry and feel emotions through our games :p


[i][b]Why are you doing this stream?[/b][/i]
If you haven't notice, there is a HUGE steam event going on right now! Since we are going through times where it is a bit harder to get together with friends and game on the same couch, we wanted to promote Steam's "Remote Play Together" feature through Shadow Puppeteer. 

We also enjoy talking about our first game, so bring on the questions!

By the way, there is a big discount going on for the game if you are interested in testing it yourself. 


We are very excited to meet you on Friday (26th) 18:00 CET!

notes.title: Soundtrack Now Available, plus a Performance Update
notes.content:
After releasing [I]Shadow Puppeteer[/I] on Wii U yesterday, we wanted to take a moment to thank the Steam community for your continued support and feedback on our game. Whether positive or negative, we take this feedback seriously and have used it to continuously improve [I]Shadow Puppeteer[/I] since the game launched on Steam in 2014. 

To show our appreciation for your support, we have released two [I]Shadow Puppeteer[/I]-related updates on Steam, both of which are based on your feedback. They are the following:

[olist]
[*][b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/439470/]SHADOW PUPPETEER SOUNDTRACK[/url][/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ECLiFv8.png[/img]

Many of you have commented on how much you enjoy the music from [I]Shadow Puppeteer[/I] and have asked whether we will make it available. Well, we have. The soundtrack, composed by Ragnhild Tronsmo Haugland, a classically trained musician/composer, and directed by Peter McConnell ([i]Grim Fandango Remastered[/i], [i]Plants vs. Zombies: Garden Warfare[/i] and [i]Star Wars: The Old Republic[/i]), is a collection of over 20 original scores, plus 20 "bonus tracks" taken directly from the game. It is now available on Steam for $2.99.  


[*][b]UPDATE #6[/b]
Today’s update is largely focused on optimization and performance, as well as the addition of some pretty loading screens :) Below are the details of this release.  

[u]Optimization[/u]
[list]
[*] Implemented occlusion culling 
[*] Static batched more assets
[*] Decreased shadowcasting on smaller objects
[*] Optimized particles
[*] Compressed meshes at a higher level
[*] Reduced camera draw distance 
[*] Removed distance fog 
[/list]

[u]Additions[/u] 
[list]
[*] Improved thread death effect
[*] Added loading screen artwork
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Removed bugs from pickups in the Cat level
[*] Fixed re-mapping of keyboard not working
[/list]

[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Added platforms in between moveable platforms in the Smelting Room level
[*] Adjusted cameras in level illumination
[/list]
[/olist]

Again, thank you for your continued support and we hope you enjoy the updates!

- The Shadow Puppeteer Team

notes.title: Update #4 PC patch
notes.content:
We released a patch today:

[list]
[*]Worked towards resolving several different causes of game crashing and missing GUI as reported by users.
[*]Fixed pickup that was missing in Dark Caverns. Verified that all pickups are now working due to feedback on other, possible missing pickups.
[*]Fixed issue with pausing/unpausing the game would make it trigger twice, causing the state to remain unchanged [/list]

Thank you for all your comments and questions in the forums. We read everything, and have been working hard on addressing the issues.

We're making some major changes to the game (like new controls), but these aren't ready to share with you yet. Please let us know if there are other issues or bugs, or if you just want to give feedback. We are listening.

notes.title: The official Shadow Puppeteer forum is up!
notes.content:
[b]The first snow has landed (here anyways), and so has our forums![/b]

You can visit the forums [url=http://shadowpuppeteer.com/forum/]here[/url].

On the forum you can follow our announcements, talk about Shadow Puppeteer and share your thoughts and ideas.

There is a support section where you can ask questions or report bugs. We will do our very best to answer and help you. 

We will still be active on our Steam Community page, so Steam users can keep posting there.

There is also a creative section where you can post videos, screenshots or other artworks.

For those of you who are registered as testers, there is a category made specifically for matters concerning testing.

Welcome to the Shadow Puppeteer forums!

All the best,
The Shadow Puppeteer Team

notes.title: Update #3: Major PC patch
notes.content:
[h1]Major Patch Update! [/h1]
We released a major patch for the game today.
[list]
[*]"Cat in Shadows": modified to make the introduction to cart in a less stressfull environment
[*]Fixed certain issues where the players would randomly die upon respawning at checkpoint, particularly in «Slinking Chimney»
[*]Fixed issue with the death animation for the Shadow looping after checkpoint respawn
[*]Fixed issue with "Continue game" button sometimes freezing the game or loading the wrong level
[*]Fixed issue with pre-rendered cutscenes ignoring the volume settings
[*]Other smaller fixes and improvements
[/list]

[h1]We still giving away Steam keys![/h1] 
We're giving one steam code to one of our followers for every milestone of 100 likes on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/ShadowPuppeteer]Shadow Puppeteer page[/url], until we reach 1000 followers! 

Thank you all for your support and feedback!

All the best, 
The Shadow Puppeteer Team

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hi Everybody,

We would like to thank you so much for your feedback and comments since we released the game.

And we wish to let you know that we uploaded some fixes for the game today. Based off of the feedback we have also chosen to balance the difficulty in certain levels, like the cat, to  create a more even playing experience. 

We hope you will keep letting us know what you think, and enjoy Shadow Puppeteer.

All the best,
The Shadow Puppeteer Team
